request.description: Search for a notation whose ISIN, specified NSINs, name, or symbol match the search value according to a tolerant full-text match algorithm. If more than one notation of an instrument matches, only the notation with the highest monetary trading volume, averaged over one month, is considered. Better matching results appear in the response before less relevant matches. If the parameter popularity is set to true, the popularity of the notation is the primary sort criterion. Popularity is affected mostly by the request frequency of the notation.
